title: Updates and durable backups
summary: Daily verified updates, atomic damaged-data handling, safe portable backups, and durable Space-image replacement make Arras easier to trust.
details: Portable .arras import stages and validates its media before replacing a layout, while atomic writes preserve the last valid state when input is damaged.
Replacing a Space image updates the persisted slot, carries its frame metadata forward, and remains safe across shared media, hidden widgets, and relaunch.
Settings controls include accessible labels, hints, and values, including a keyboard-reachable Advanced Frame disclosure.
Every release must provide deliberate human-authored notes that CI uses for both the GitHub release and updater message.
